comparison.objective: Tip a rocker so an eccentric counterweight clears a stop and settles on the other stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold one articulated body displaced while rotating a second coupled element past an obstruction.
comparison.success_condition: Counterweight passes the post and the released rocker rests on its new stop.
comparison.reason: This close coupled-control task changes a rocker configuration but does not set a calibrated screw, lock it with a nut, or verify repeated opening cycles.
